resources.string: Understand lottery entry, reservations and the profile associated with your device.
Joining a lottery pool expresses interest in a date block. It does not reserve a campsite or require payment. Entry does not guarantee selection.
Selection gives you a next step, not confirmed dates. Choose from available dates and complete the reservation process. Your preferred dates may no longer be available.
Quadle recognizes your device without a password. Profile details and entries are associated with that device identity. Access on a new device or after clearing data is not assured.
Read the owner\'s rules before confirming a stay. Cancellation terms appear on each listing and apply to confirmed reservations, not lottery entries.
Make room for nature, your neighbours and the next camper.
For urgent danger, contact local emergency services. Follow posted notices and current local restrictions.
Keep noise low, stay within your assigned site and respect shared facilities. Follow the campsite\'s guest limit and owner instructions.
Pack out litter and food scraps. Use designated trails, protect vegetation and leave natural objects where you find them.
Check weather and local fire restrictions. Use designated fire pits only when permitted, fully extinguish fires and store food away from wildlife.
